newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Realty Income EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Realty Income EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Tuesday it lowered its estimate for Realty Income Corp's fourth-quarter earnings to $0.54 a share from $0.55.
-- On Monday, Realty reported third-quarter FFO earnings of $0.51 versus $0.50 a year earlier. The results were in line with Everen's and consensus estimates, Everen said.
-- Realty had $10 million in acquisitions during the quarter, purchasing 11 properties with an average cap rate of 10.4 percent.
-- Everen said its reduced estimate reflects lower-than-expected acquisitions all year.
